title: Rename utils/date to utils/dates, add isSameUtcDay, drop legacyFormat
description:
Housekeeping before the dashboard work:

- `src/utils/date.ts` → `src/utils/dates.ts` to match `strings.ts`/`numbers.ts`; both importers updated
- new `isSameUtcDay`, used by the stats endpoint to flag today's (partial) bucket for the dashboard
- deletes `legacyFormat.ts`: its last caller, the v1 CSV export, was removed in March (`git grep formatLegacyDate` is empty)
